proposal.reason: Main change is to contribution/review automation: reviewer request synchronization and withdrawals in `review_automation.py`, approval status wording/summary behavior in `maintainer_approval.py`, and squash-preview publication moving to PR check-runs in `commit_message_squash.py`, plus matching Actions permission wiring and workflow docs. These are review/merge policy and supporting workflow-script changes, not CI test execution or runtime PCCL modules.
